description: Adds an office note to a client's record (category general, access, preference, alert or scheduling; pinned keeps it surfaced). Only the team sees it; nothing is sent. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat returns the original note.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: add_client_note
title: Add a note to a client
